privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Coolbooks ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our Service.<return></return><return></return><title>1. Information We Collect</title>Account Information:<return></return>- Email address (for account creation and communication)<return></return>- Username or display name<return></return>- Password (encrypted)<return></return>- Account creation date<return></return><return></return>Payment Information:<return></return>- Payment information is processed by third-party payment providers<return></return>- We do not store full credit card or banking details<return></return>- We may store transaction history and subscription status<return></return><return></return>Content Data:<return></return>- Books you create (text, images, metadata)<return></return>- AI prompts and preferences you submit<return></return>- Privacy settings for your books (public or private)<return></return>- Books you read or interact with<return></return><return></return>Technical Information:<return></return>- Device type and operating system<return></return>- App version<return></return>- IP address<return></return>- Usage statistics and crash reports<return></return>- Log files and error messages<return></return><return></return><title>2. How We Use Your Information</title>We use collected information to:<return></return>- Provide and maintain the Service<return></return>- Process your subscription and payments<return></return>- Generate AI-powered books based on your inputs<return></return>- Store and display your created books<return></return>- Communicate with you about your account and the Service<return></return>- Improve and optimize the Service<return></return>- Detect and prevent fraud or abuse<return></return>- Comply with legal obligations<return></return><return></return><title>3. AI and Data Processing</title>- Your prompts and inputs are processed by artificial intelligence systems<return></return>- AI providers may process your data according to their own privacy policies<return></return>- We do not use your personal information to train AI models without consent<return></return>- Generated content is stored on our servers<return></return><return></return><title>4. Information Sharing</title>We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with:<return></return><return></return>Third-Party Service Providers:<return></return>- Payment processors (for subscription billing)<return></return>- AI service providers (for book generation)<return></return>- Cloud hosting services (for data storage)<return></return>- Analytics providers (for Service improvement)<return></return><return></return>Public Content:<return></return>- Books you set as "public" are visible to all users<return></return>- Your username may be displayed with public books<return></return><return></return>Legal Requirements:<return></return>- We may disclose information if required by law<return></return>- To protect our rights, safety, or property<return></return>- To investigate fraud or violations of our Terms<return></return><return></return><title>5.
